c_charter.title: LOA Charter
c_charter.text: Lunar Operations Agency, chartered July 20, 1969. Before that date the agency — and all of its hardware — did not exist.

c_selene_brief.title: Selene-1 Brief
c_selene_brief.text: Mia Halloran. 30-day solo surface stay, Mare Serenitatis. Habitat at the lander, Site Alpha 1.2 km north-east.

c_sample_14.title: Sample #14 — Basalt
c_sample_14.text: Fine-grained basalt from the shadow at Site Alpha. Mia: 'It's warm. I can feel it through the glove.'

c_thermal_alpha.title: Thermal Survey — Site Alpha
c_thermal_alpha.text: Shadowed regolith at Site Alpha: -23 °C. Nothing in that shadow should be warm.

c_pse_d1.title: PSE Log — Night 12
c_pse_d1.text: Three micro-tremors: 02:14, 02:25, 02:36 — eleven minutes apart. Flagged 'thermal'.

c_pse_d2.title: PSE Log — Night 13
c_pse_d2.text: Tremors every 11.2 minutes, all day. Source depth about 40 m, directly beneath Site Alpha.

c_radio_hum.title: S-Band Hum
c_radio_hum.text: Low carrier noise on Mia's voice loop. It swells and fades every 11.2 minutes.

c_geophone.title: Geophone Array
c_geophone.text: Pulse shape repeats: 3-1-4 … 3-1-4 … Not noise. A pattern.

c_hq_order.title: HQ Order 71-114
c_hq_order.text: Classify the pulse as an instrument fault. The crew is not to be informed.

c_supply.title: Resupply Schedule
c_supply.text: Selene-2 cargo lander delayed to March 19. Crew to conserve consumables.

c_probe_photo.title: Helmet Cam Frame 0412
c_probe_photo.text: A squat metal shape half-buried at the bottom of Rille Bend. Pitted, old, humming.
